notes.title: Cats in Time from Pine Studio is out!
notes.content:
Cats in Time is a relaxing puzzle game where you explore 3D dioramas, solve puzzles, and save cats lost in time. The game is a cute mix of room escape and hidden object games, but with cats! 

Cats in Time by Pine Studio - go save some cats!

The main goal of every level is to find ten missing cats(290 in total), but that simple task is not so simple when they are so purrfect at hiding (as you already know from our games ;)). You'll have to solve numerous mechanical puzzles to open boxes, doors, roofs, holes, cars, and other weird places.

notes.title: First Patch and Russian translation!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

The first patch is now up! It includes a number of bug fixes and improvements to the settings, such as sensitivity sliders and V-sync support. Camera controls have also been adjusted based on feedback from our players, but work on that still continues.

We also added Russian localization. Special thanks to Алексей Февральский for providing the translation.

Thank you all for your patience and valuable feedback.
